platform: Linux aarch64 container on Docker Linux VM / Apple M1 Max host
storage: private temporary directory on Docker named volume
limits: Single approximately 94-second paced synthetic run; not real applications or hours/days of continuous operation.
Warm overlap means at least one cold worker had not completed at query start; not necessarily simultaneous filesystem I/O.
Handler latency excludes request creation, response validation and warm pacing; wall time and CPU include the driver.
Logical successful snapshot bytes are not physical device writes.
CPU has 10 ms granularity; RSS includes initialization and all worker threads.
No network DNS, TUN or QUIC path, host network changes or service restart.
Cold workers remain active during pacing sleeps; overlap does not imply disk activity. Sample arrays grow with query count and contribute to peak RSS.
